SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 
  AND fish_date_doy >= 175
  AND fish_date_doy <= 182
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats_scheduled
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 
  AND fish_date_doy >= 183
  AND fish_date_doy <= 200
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c)::numeric, 2) as avg_temp_c,
  MIN(wtmp_c) as min_temp_c,
  MAX(wtmp_c) as max_temp_c,
  COUNT(*) as readings
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 
  AND ts_doy >= 175
  AND ts_doy <= 185
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy;
